candidates.statement: Walk the chosen neighbourhood on a weekday evening and hand-claim 5 venues at the bar.
candidates.rationale: The documented first move for a local marketplace is founder-led, in-person supply recruitment. It is also the cheapest possible test of whether this wedge needs a salesperson the company does not have.

candidates.statement: Ship the smallest claim surface a bartender can use on a phone behind the bar: claim, fix hours, done.
candidates.rationale: The walk-in has nothing to hand over without it. Anything beyond claim-and-fix-hours is a feature for venues that do not exist yet.
